title: FIN 30210 Managerial Economics
text:
Eleven lessons that build from scarcity and opportunity cost through supply and demand, production and cost, profit maximization, market structure, and game theory.
    Use the arrow keys to move through a deck. Press S for speaker notes, F for full screen, and E for a print layout you can save as a PDF.
  

  
    Lessons
    
      
        
          1
          Managerial economics and microeconomics
          Scarcity, opportunity cost, models, and the theory of the firm
        
      
      
        
          2
          Math review
          Functions, derivatives, partial derivatives, and constrained optimization
        
      
      
        
          3
          The essentials of supply and demand
          Demand, market demand, estimation, supply, and equilibrium
        
      
      
        
          4
          Elasticity
          Price, income, and cross-price elasticity, and elasticity and revenue
        
      
      
        
          5
          Production
          The production function, Cobb-Douglas, returns to scale, and marginal product
        
      
      
        
          6
          Production, part 2
          Output elasticity, the stages of production, and isoquants
        
      
      
        
          7
          Costs
          Short-run cost curves, learning curves, economies of scale and scope
        
      
      
        
          8
          Profit and revenue maximization
          Isocost lines, optimal inputs, the expansion path, and profit
        
      
      
        
          9
          Perfect competition and monopoly
          Shutdown and exit, monopoly pricing, the Lerner index, and welfare
        
      
      
        
          10
          Monopolistic competition and oligopoly
          Concentration, kinked demand, Cournot, Bertrand, Stackelberg, and collusion
        
      
      
        
          11
          Introduction to game theory
          Nash equilibrium, the prisoners' dilemma, repeated and sequential games
